mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair renal function and increase enoxaparin accumulation, elevating bleeding risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely, adjust enoxaparin dosing if creatinine clearance declines, maintain electrolyte levels, and assess for bleeding signs; consider alternative antifungal if possible.
